title: I finally returned to MallWorld after months of being unable to
content: Return to MallWorld After a full week off of any kind of THC, I finally returned to MallWorld, also I think the Melatonin I’m taking to help sleep is contributing. Woke up this morning and immediately began typing this up in my phone. I KNEW I was back, I wouldn’t say I was fully lucid but getting closer to what I used to be. I was a very stoic version of myself, like I knew something unseen or unknown, but was observing and looking out for things that my fellow dreamspace visitors were maybe unaware of. I was represented exactly like I do in real life, white male, head to toe black, wearing slim jeans, Vans sneakers, a black jacket, a black slouch beanie on my head and black glasses. I had my phone out and was taking pictures of everything and everyone, as if to document it all AND draw attention to myself. If you saw this individual, I may have seen you. There were these locations I visited: THE MANSION: A very nice house I’ve been to before, like a modernist mansion from the late 70s to early 80s… dark wood with gold or brass details and trims. It had a pool in the back, surrounded by forests in the distance. The whole thing seemed elevated or very high off the ground. Possibly a lake behind. Lots of panoramic glass windows in the back facing pool. People I know in real life were there along with unknown guests, maybe you? White dude with facial hair wearing blue swim shorts came out from the backyard pool area up a staircase telling us the temperature of the water was good. THE PLATFORM: A strange series of walkways or platforms that served as the “under structure” of the mansion, keeping it elevated from the ground floor. Imagine a steel and concrete slab skyscraper being built but before the outer walls are placed. Solid floor, solid ceiling, but concrete and metal beams and walls everywhere. Guardrails at the exposed outer edges. We were all very crowded as these outer edges also had rail lines for incoming, very slow moving light rail trains painted in orange and white stripes. Lots of us were pulling and grabbing our friends and family members out of the way of these trains even though they seemed mostly harmless due to their speed and size. I believe that these trains take you to different places in the MallWorld. Apparently a huge thunderstorm was on its way because there was a problem with water rushing down towards the ground level of the platform. We were using sandbags and large 70 lb (31.75 kg) bags of concrete to block small paths and drainage canals from letting water get too close. THE MALL: It reminded me aesthetically of my REAL local mall around the early 2000s before they did a massive renovation that kinda ruined the fun. This is where I did all of my photo taking I mentioned earlier. I found a large number of visitors gathering in groups on double staircases that faced each other, and met on a middle floating landing that then continued to the bottom. Most of you were gathering on the higher floor at the top of the stairs or glass guardrails. I was on the lower center platform taking photos of the groups and interior design of the mall. All of you seemed excited to be there and perhaps aware of each other, pointing, waving, and smiling. There was also a very large, wide clothing store with a central aisle cutting through all the racks and displays of clothing. Somewhat dim track lighting along the edges where the walls met the ceilings. Large shiny black counter at the end for ringing up. I was walking to the back of the store to gain access to the utility hallways that all connect in the back. RETURN TO THE MANSION: Back at the mansion. Everyone was gathered around the mansion in different spots with lively conversation and debate being had. As I walked in a young dark-haired teenage girl found me and said, “They need your help, they’re in the dining room” I make my way there and there’s a group of people at a large, round wooden table. They had sketches, notes taped to the wall… even one of those “conspiracy walls” with pinned string connecting notes and drawings, only it looks like they used strips of white gauze instead. They were trying to “map out” the way MallWorld was connected or designed! Anyway the young girl silenced everyone and said “He’s here” at which I took a seat at the table with all eyes on me. I clicked a pen and put it onto a notepad and said something along the lines of “Okay, lets start putting this all together” Sadly it ends there, maybe I went TOO lucid and slipped out of the dream. But it was an incredibly vivid one for being my return to this place after MONTHS of being unable to visit. I hope something in my description rings a bell with you, I think some of us crossed may have crossed paths last night. For reference, I woke up at exactly 8 AM Eastern time
